description: Roof repair, replacement and storm damage.

emergency.safety_script: If part of the ceiling is sagging or has collapsed, move everyone out of that room. If anyone is in danger, call 911.

faqs.a: I can connect you to the on-call team about emergency leak and storm damage calls.

faqs.q: Can you give me a price for a new roof?
faqs.a: The team prices a roof after an inspection, so I cannot give one on the call.

faqs.q: Do you work with insurance claims?
faqs.a: I can note that it is an insurance claim and the team will explain their process.
Yes. I can book an inspection visit.

qualifying_questions: Is the roof leaking right now?
Is the damage from a recent storm?
What type of roof is it, if you know?
Is this a home or a commercial building?
